title: MeshCore Platform
description: Heard traffic, node registry and repeater telemetry from a MeshCore companion radio on USB serial.

panels.title: Frames heard
panels.description: Every frame the radio demodulated, repeats included -- this is what the channel actually cost in airtime.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_rx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "len")
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: Unique packets
panels.description: Frames whose packet hash was not already seen inside the dedupe window: the real traffic behind the airtime.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_rx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "len" and r.dup == "0")
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: Repeated
panels.description: Share of frames that were rebroadcasts of a packet already heard. High is normal in a dense flood mesh.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_rx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "len")
  |> group()
  |> reduce(
      identity: {total: 0.0, dups: 0.0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
        total: accumulator.total + 1.0,
        dups: accumulator.dups + (if r.dup == "1" then 1.0 else 0.0),
      }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if r.total > 0.0 then 100.0 * r.dups / r.total else 0.0}))

panels.title: Adverts
panels.description: Advert frames -- the ones carrying node identity.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_rx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "len" and r.ptype == "ADVERT")
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: Nodes heard
panels.description: Distinct public keys seen advertising.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_node" and r._field == "heard")
  |> group(columns: ["pubkey"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: Radio link
panels.description: Whether the collector currently holds the serial link.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_collector" and r._field == "serial_up")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value then 1 else 0}))
  |> group()

panels.title: Frames by payload type
panels.description: Stacked count per interval. Types beyond the six charted individually are folded into Other so a colour always means the same kind of traffic.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_rx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "len")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with ptype:
      if contains(value: r.ptype, set: ["REQ", "PATH", "ANON_REQ", "GRP_TXT", "ADVERT", "RESPONSE"]) then r.ptype else "Other"}))
  |> group(columns: ["ptype"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if exists r._value then r._value else 0}))

panels.title: Frames by hop count
panels.description: How far traffic has travelled before reaching this receiver. 0 means heard directly from the sender.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_rx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "len")
  |> group(columns: ["hops"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with order: if r.hops =~ /^[0-9]+$/ then int(v: r.hops) else 99}))
  |> sort(columns: ["order"])
  |> keep(columns: ["hops", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "frames"})

panels.title: SNR distribution
panels.description: Every frame's signal-to-noise, bucketed. Bands correspond to distinct sets of neighbours.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_rx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "snr")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: Mean SNR by hop count
panels.description: Signal quality does not decay with hop count -- each hop is its own local link -- so a slope here says something about which repeaters are reaching us.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_rx")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "snr")
  |> group(columns: ["hops"])
  |> mean()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with order: if r.hops =~ /^[0-9]+$/ then int(v: r.hops) else 99}))
  |> sort(columns: ["order"])
  |> keep(columns: ["hops", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "mean SNR"})

panels.title: Local radio noise floor
panels.description: From the companion radio's own stats. Empty until the collector runs against real hardware.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_local" and r._field == "noise_floor")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Node registry
panels.description: Built from overheard adverts. Keyed on public key, so a node that renames itself stays one row.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_node" and r._field == "snr")
  |> group(columns: ["pubkey", "name", "type"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "pubkey", "name", "type", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "last heard", _value: "SNR"})

panels.title: Node locations
panels.description: Only nodes that advertise coordinates appear.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_node")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon")
  |> group(columns: ["pubkey", "name", "type", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["pubkey", "name", "type"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["pubkey"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["pubkey", "name", "type", "lat", "lon"])

panels.title: Battery
panels.description: From the binary status request. The telemetry path reports the same cell in volts, which is a free cross-check that both decoders agree.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_repeater" and r._field == "bat")
  |> group(columns: ["repeater"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: MCU temperature, from the LPP telemetry request. The binary status struct has no temperature field, so this is the only path that carries it.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_repeater_telem")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "temperature")
  |> group(columns: ["repeater", "channel"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: TX queue depth
panels.description: A queue that does not drain means the repeater is transmitting slower than it is being asked to.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_repeater" and r._field == "tx_queue_len")
  |> group(columns: ["repeater"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Round-trip time
panels.description: How long a status request took over the mesh.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_repeater" and r._field == "rtt_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["repeater"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Repeater status
panels.description: Latest reading per repeater you own and have credentials for.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_repeater")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "uptime" or r._field == "bat"
                    or r._field == "tx_queue_len" or r._field == "nb_recv"
                    or r._field == "flood_dups" or r._field == "rtt_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["repeater", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["repeater"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["repeater", "uptime", "bat", "tx_queue_len", "nb_recv",
                    "flood_dups", "rtt_ms"])

panels.title: Repeater sensors
panels.description: Latest value for every LPP telemetry channel, including any external sensors.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_repeater_telem")
  |> group(columns: ["repeater", "type", "channel"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["repeater", "type", "channel", "_value", "_time"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "value", _time: "reading"})
  |> sort(columns: ["repeater", "type"])

panels.title: Repeater neighbours
panels.description: Zero-hop neighbours each repeater can hear. Neighbour keys use the same 12-hex prefix as the node table, so the two join.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_neighbour" and r._field == "snr")
  |> group(columns: ["repeater", "neighbour"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["repeater", "neighbour", "_value", "_time"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "SNR", _time: "seen"})

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_collector" and r._field == "points_written")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Points dropped
panels.description: Non-zero means writes are being rejected or the buffer overflowed. Should stay flat.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_collector" and r._field == "points_dropped")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Spool on disk
panels.description: Growing means InfluxDB is unreachable but nothing is being lost yet.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_collector" and r._field == "spool_bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
